'''Yarille''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Yarille system/Legends|Yarille system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
Yarille was affected by the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], suffering extensive damage to the surface due to a [[Battle of Yarille|battle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].
